title: RAW source sketch: Galen II.44.2 as a whole two-goal boiling account with replacement-water identity
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Retains the complete owned II.44.2 passage as an explicitly bounded alternative sketch: drying requires first-water disposal, immediate transfer to other hot water and renewed boiling; evacuation avoids thorough boiling to retain juice. This concretizes an existing source card, not a new source discovery or executed target meaning. No target or dictionary is yet bound.

exact_section.greek: ξηρᾶναι δ’ ὑγρὰν γαϲτέρα βουληθέντεϲ, ὅταν ἤδη μετρίωϲ ἡψῆϲθαι δοκῇ, τὸ πρότερον ὕδωρ ἀποχέοντεϲ ἐμβαλοῦμεν εὐθέωϲ ἑτέρῳ θερμῷ κἄπειτα πάλιν ἐν ἐκείνῳ καθεψήϲομεν, ὡϲ τακερὰν γενέϲθαι, μὴ καθέψοντεϲ, ὅταν ὑπαγωγῆϲ ἕνεκα λαμβάνηται. βουλόμεθα γὰρ οὐκ ἀποθέϲθαι πάντα τὸν ἴδιον αὐτῆϲ χυλὸν ἐπὶ τῆϲ τοιαύτηϲ χρείαϲ, ἀλλὰ φυλάττειν ὅϲον οἵόν τε μάλιϲτα. τελέωϲ μὲν οὖν φυλάττειν τὸν ἴδιον χυλὸν οὐδὲν τῶν ἑψομένων δύναται, μᾶλλον δ’ ἀποβάλλει τὰ μέχρι πλείονοϲ ἑψηθέντα.
exact_section.english_working_translation: But when wishing to dry a moist belly, once it seems moderately boiled, pouring away the former water we shall immediately put it into other hot water and then boil it thoroughly again in that, so that it becomes soft. We do not boil it thoroughly when it is taken for evacuation. For in that use we wish not to lose all its own juice, but to preserve as much as possible. None of the things being boiled can preserve its own juice completely; those boiled for longer lose more.
exact_section.translation_status: Own source-side semantic translation; not a target reading or certified modern pharmacology.

complete_selected_source.scope: All of 2.44.2 only, including the explanation and general limits at its end. The five-section parent remains byte-unchanged; this is not presented as a translation of the complete cabbage entry.
complete_selected_source.context: Its plant identity and the juice/body explanation come from the retained parent entry. The two preparations are alternative uses of the material, not two goals imposed on one already served physical portion.

full_content_obligations: Wait until material seems moderately boiled.
Immediately put that material into other hot water.
Boil it again in that replacement water until soft.
For evacuation, do not thoroughly boil it.
The reason in that use is to preserve as much of its own juice as possible rather than lose all.
No boiled thing preserves all its juice; longer boiling loses more.

concrete_typed_sketch.entities: Plant serving R, first cooking water W0, replacement water W1 with W1!=W0 and HOT(W1); goal DRY or EVACUATE. Branches are counterfactual preparations of a serving of the same kind, not simultaneous histories of one consumed portion.
concrete_typed_sketch.dry_plan: MODERATELY_BOILED(R,W0) -> DISCARD(W0) -> IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER(R,W0,W1) -> BOIL_AGAIN(R,W1) UNTIL SOFT(R).
concrete_typed_sketch.evacuation_policy: DO_NOT_BOIL_THOROUGHLY(R); retain as much juice as possible. This does not mean zero boiling or total juice preservation.
concrete_typed_sketch.relations: The second boil consumes the W1 reference, not W0. For otherwise matched source-side comparisons, LONGER_BOILED predicts MORE_JUICE_LOST; there is no numerical mass or proportional-loss equation.

new_content_relative_to_completed_amulet: The material changes container/water and is heated again; the chosen therapeutic purpose reverses the permitted continuation. None of these transitions follows from the I.1.39 engraving/enclosure plan. They are, however, already explicit in RAW402 source content, so this card does not claim a newly discovered source law.
specific_competing_bindings: Former-water resumption: bind the second boil to W0 after it has been discarded, versus the written other hot water W1. This changes the physical process and the source reference, not just a label.
One uninterrupted thorough-boil recipe for both goals versus conditional short/long treatment: the latter permits a drying branch and inhibits thorough boiling for evacuation.
Independent water identity and juice retention must stay separate: changing water does not alone prove a numerical quantity of retained juice.
strongest_countercases: RAW482 already retains the stronger exposure-history condition from 2.44.3; a later complete-entry reading must not omit it by treating this smaller source section as the whole parent.

Air/cold-water exposure is not in selected 2.44.2 and is not silently converted to a present-temperature flag. The full source says exposed material fails proper softening, not a proven gut-effect reversal.
No explicit instruction discards the second water before serving.
Reported drying/evacuation and softness are historical source claims, not clinical validation.
A source-level comparison alone does not identify any Voynich operation or select this content over other possible complete readings.
